refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.oom is the internal interface between the service manager (systemd1, PID 1) and systemd-oomd.service8, served by the latter on the /run/systemd/oom/io.systemd.ManagedOOM socket. PID 1 watches unit cgroups and reports them to systemd-oomd via ReportManagedOOMCGroups(), together with the ManagedOOMMode configured per unit (for example kill) and the involved ControlGroup properties such as pressure limits and property rules. It is not intended to be consumed by third-party programs.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: The interface is an implementation detail of the PID 1 ↔ systemd-oomd protocol. The socket is owned by the system oomd instance; callers other than PID 1 have no business invoking it.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.oom
type ManagedOOMMode( auto, kill )
type ControlGroup( mode: ManagedOOMMode, path: string, property: string, limit: ?int, duration: ?int, rules: ?[]string )
method ReportManagedOOMCGroups( cgroups: []ControlGroup ) -> ()

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.oom interface was added in version 249.
ControlGroup, ManagedOOMMode, and ReportManagedOOMCGroups() were added in version 249.
